style: Anime, 12 fps feel (limited animation, held key poses, snappy motion), dynamic camera and action. Warm orange and teal color grade: sodium-vapor orange practical lights against cool teal shadows. Tense prison-break thriller with spy-film energy; red and blue police light accents during alarms. Video audio: step clips get sound effects and foley but No music; idle/thinking loops are silent.
shotRules: Valid shot types: wide, medium, close-up, macro. Vary them within a multi-shot clip.
Respect the rule of thirds, use leading lines (bars, corridors, pipes, catwalks), keep eyelines consistent across cuts.
Step clips are 15 seconds with FAST CUTS every 2-4 seconds (roughly 5-6 shots). Pack in more action per second.
Use a variety of shot types in every clip; never repeat the same shot type back to back.
Every successful step clip must END on a close-up of the protagonist's face.

characters.description: Larry (inmate 4471). Lean, wiry young man, late 20s, sharp determined eyes, messy black hair with a single scar through the left eyebrow. Wears a RED prison jumpsuit (the only red jumpsuit in the prison), sleeves tied at the waist over a charcoal tank top, taped wrists, amber eyes, '4471' on his back.
Towering veteran sergeant, grey buzz cut, thick mustache, heavy baton.
Young rookie guard, oversized cap, nervous eyes, clutching a clipboard.
Stern woman lieutenant, tight bun, mirrored aviator sunglasses, radio on shoulder.
Heavyset guard with a jangling key ring and a donut-crumb uniform.
Silent watchtower sniper, balaclava, long rifle, night-vision goggles on helmet.
K-9 handler with a German shepherd, cargo pants, bite-proof sleeve.
Wiry, paranoid control-room guard with headset, glasses reflecting CCTV monitors.
Bald riot-squad brute in black tactical armor and a scratched visor helmet.
Older warden's right-hand, crisp navy dress uniform, silver hair, cold smile.
Lanky night-shift guard, dark eye bags, flashlight, coffee thermos.
Tall sturdy lifer, long grey-streaked hair in a back braid, long braided beard, worn orange jumpsuit with torn holes, calm gentle eyes, carries a small worn book.
Skinny tech-savvy hacker kid, taped glasses, restless hands.
Old con man, slicked-back white hair, gold tooth, deck of cards.
Muscular boxer with taped knuckles and a flattened nose.
Quiet artist with paint-stained fingers and long dreadlocks tied back.
Twitchy smuggler with shaved head, many pockets sewn into his jumpsuit.
Stoic ex-soldier, grey crew cut, dog tags, military posture.
Flamboyant kitchen worker, hairnet, huge grin, ladle.
Hulking gang leader, facial tattoos, shades, surrounded by loyalty.
Nimble acrobat-thief, small frame, wrapped wrists, mischievous smirk.

environments.description: The protagonist's cramped cell in Block A: steel bunk, sink, barred door facing a multi-tier cell block.
Upper tier catwalk of the cell block, railings, long drop, rows of barred doors.
Main corridor with barred checkpoint gates, fluorescent lights, painted floor lines.
Long steel tables, serving line, trays, guards on a raised walkway.
Industrial kitchen, steam, knives chained down, walk-in freezer, service door.
Huge washers and dryers, laundry carts piled with jumpsuits and sheets.
Outdoor exercise yard, weights, basketball hoop, chain-link fence, watchtower overhead.
Prison workshop, license plate presses, tools on shadow boards, sparks.
Sterile infirmary, curtained beds, medicine cabinet, barred windows.
Cramped library, tall shelves, law books, a cart of returns.
Tiled communal showers, dripping pipes, a loose drain grate.
Solitary confinement, pitch-dark cells, heavy steel doors with slots.
Visitation room, glass partitions, phones, a visitor exit door guarded.
Control room, wall of CCTV monitors, key lockers, door release panel.
Wood-paneled warden's office, safe, window overlooking the yard.
Cramped sheet-metal air ducts, fan blades, slatted light from rooms below. Obscure path.
Underground utility tunnels, steam pipes, valve wheels, caged work lights.
Storm drain beneath the prison, ankle-deep water, rusted grate to the outside. Obscure path, exit candidate.
Prison rooftop, HVAC units, searchlight sweeps, razor wire edge. Exit candidate.

Tall concrete guard tower at the corner of the yard and perimeter fence: spiral stairs, a glass-walled lookout cabin with a rotating searchlight, rifle rack, radio console, and a catwalk ladder over the fence line.
Double razor-wire perimeter fence, guard tower, searchlights, dogs. Exit candidate.
Loading dock with delivery trucks, roll-up doors, guard checking manifests. Exit candidate.
